name: Hermes
description: What Hermes Agent (Nous Research) does on this machine, in its main home and each profile: sessions running now, usage and its cost as Hermes records it, by day, project and model, each session's conversation, its memory and its scheduled jobs. Read from Hermes' own files, nothing saved.

hermes-sessions.description: sessions open now, then the latest ones
hermes-sessions.live: Hermes' database on the machine the server runs on (~/.hermes/state.db)

recent.description: how many recent sessions to list after the open ones

account.description: one profile's (default for the main home, else its name); all of them when left out

machine.description: another machine's (its id in the Machines plugin's list)

hermes-usage.description: its cost as Hermes recorded it and tokens per day, today and over the last days
hermes-usage.live: Hermes' database on the machine the server runs on (~/.hermes/state.db)

days.description: how many days back it covers, up to 30

account.description: one profile's (default for the main home, else its name); all of them when left out

machine.description: another machine's (its id in the Machines plugin's list)

hermes-projects.description: its usage by project over the last days (a chat app's sessions under the app's name)
hermes-projects.live: Hermes' database on the machine the server runs on (~/.hermes/state.db)

days.description: how many days back it covers, up to 30

hermes-models.live: Hermes' database on the machine the server runs on (~/.hermes/state.db)
